normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 visible terminal-cell rows after ANSI-control removal and outer-whitespace trimming. Every row also pins exact raw projected and rendered hashes plus one-based inclusive blank-column ranges.
policy: Fail-closed review of all 130 surviving lexical rows immediately bracketed by accepted redactions in the post-Batch-49 gallery. Accept only spans proven to continue the same disposable prose, greeting, solicitation, process-commentary, or filler family. Retain functional interface and BBS copy, titles, identities, attribution, structural lettering, authored dialogue, narrative and captions, source-significant content, and ambiguous fragments. Completed-history collisions and tracked accepted projections are forbidden.
